newsitem.title: UK: JR East 10-year bond to exceed $600 million - leads.
newsitem.headline: JR East 10-year bond to exceed $600 million - leads.

text.p: East Japan Railway Co's upcoming 10-year Eurobond will be for more than $600 million, joint lead managers IBJ International and Goldman Sachs International said at a presentation in London on Thursday.
The bond will be launched before the end of September, they said, but declined to give further details.
Market talk was for a launch spread in the high-30s basis points over U.S. Treasury notes, with some dealers specifying a 36 to 38 b.p. range.
JR East last tapped the international bond market in 1994, when it issued a $600 million 10-year Eurobond. JR East is rated AA by Standard & Poor's and Aa2 by Moody's.
